config.video_gen.test_desc: Verify provider connectivity without generating a video.
config.video_gen.provider_desc: Select a provider configured in Provider Management. Supported types: MiniMax, Google Veo, and Agnes AI.
config.video_gen.limits_desc: Control daily usage and how long AuraGo waits for asynchronous video jobs.
config.video_gen.defaults_desc: Defaults used when the tool call does not specify clip settings.
config.video_gen.disabled_desc: Enable the toggle above to let the agent generate videos.
config.video_gen.enabled_help: Lets the agent create videos with the selected provider. Every generation uses quota or credit.
config.video_gen.provider_help: Provider from Provider Management that creates the videos.
config.video_gen.duration_help: Length of a clip in seconds (1-30, default 6) when the agent does not specify one. Longer clips cost more.
config.video_gen.resolution_help: Resolution when the agent does not specify one. The available values depend on the provider.
config.video_gen.aspect_ratio_help: Aspect ratio when the agent does not specify one, for example 16:9 for landscape and 9:16 for portrait.
config.video_gen.poll_interval_help: How often AuraGo asks the provider for the state of a video job (1-120 seconds, default 10).
config.video_gen.timeout_help: After this time AuraGo stops waiting for a video (30-3600 seconds, default 600).
config.video_gen.max_daily_help: Maximum number of videos per day. 0 means unlimited.
